import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a violin plot to compare sleep duration by age group
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Sleep Duration by Age Group and Gender')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

sns.countplot(x='Occupation', hue='Physical Activity Level', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Physical Activity Levels by Occupation')
plt.xlabel('Occupation')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Physical Activity Level')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a violin plot to compare sleep duration by age group
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.violinplot(x='Age', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Sleep Duration by Age Group and Gender')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart to compare physical activity levels by occupation
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='Occupation', hue='Physical Activity Level', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Physical Activity Levels by Occupation')
plt.xlabel('Occupation')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Physical Activity Level')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a heatmap to visualize the correlation between health metrics
plt.figure(figsize=(10,8))
corr_matrix = sleep_health[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'BMI Category', 'Blood Pressure', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation between Health Metrics')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
